# Show Content for One Choice

A `<ShowWhen>` block shows its content only while another block's output has a given value:

```mdx
<ShowWhen output="pick_provider.GIT_PROVIDER" equals="gitlab">

...

</ShowWhen>
```

Until the output exists, the content shows, so you can read every case first. Add `whenUnknown="hide"` to hide it until then.

## Pick a provider

<Inputs id="provider">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: Provider
    type: enum
    options: [github, gitlab]
    default: github
```
</Inputs>

<Command
  id="pick-provider"
  outputs={["GIT_PROVIDER"]}
  inputsId="provider"
  title="Use this provider"
  env={{ PROVIDER: "{{ .inputs.Provider }}" }}
  command='echo "GIT_PROVIDER=$PROVIDER" >> "$RUNBOOK_OUTPUT"'
/>

Run the command, then pick the other provider and run it again. The steps below follow it.

## Set up access

<ShowWhen output="pick_provider.GIT_PROVIDER" equals="github">

**On GitHub**, install the app on your repository.

<Command id="github-step" title="Set up GitHub" command='echo "Set up GitHub"' />

</ShowWhen>

<ShowWhen output="pick_provider.GIT_PROVIDER" equals="gitlab">

**On GitLab**, add a token as a CI/CD variable.

<Command id="gitlab-step" title="Set up GitLab" command='echo "Set up GitLab"' />

</ShowWhen>

<ShowWhen output="pick_provider.GIT_PROVIDER" in={["github", "gitlab"]} whenUnknown="hide">

You picked a provider. This shows only once **Use this provider** has run.

</ShowWhen>
